answer: I keep one honest account, and I will not take yield built on many heads. All bonds sharing one funding root must anchor in a single harbor, and each epoch the network sends a pulse through that harbor: if one head cheats, every bond in the harbor is burned at once. Ten heads pay ten bonds and one slip destroys all ten, so expected ruin grows about 100-fold while reward stays flat. There is no oasis where a fleet can hide a second head from the pulse. Means first, then reward.
